question: Which saved hotels in ZIP 16802 have one room October 10 to October 12, 2026 for under $250 total?

proposal.sql: SELECT h.hotel_id FROM saved_hotels h JOIN saved_hotel_zips z ON z.hotel_id=h.hotel_id JOIN demo_hotel_nights n ON n.hotel_id=h.hotel_id WHERE z.postcode=:postcode AND n.stay_date>=:check_in AND n.stay_date<:check_out GROUP BY h.hotel_id HAVING COUNT(n.stay_date)=:nights AND MIN(n.rooms_available)>=:rooms AND SUM(n.nightly_rate_cents)*:rooms<:budget ORDER BY SUM(n.nightly_rate_cents), h.hotel_id LIMIT 3
